title_options: Fans Spent $3.79 Billion on GTA 6. Here's Who Actually Got It.
You Paid $80 for GTA 6. Here's Where Every Dollar Went.
GTA 6 Sold $3.79 Billion in a Day. Who Got Paid, and When?
promise: After watching, you know who takes each part of an $80 GTA 6 download, and why none of it lands on launch night.

creator_evidence.what: Payment-flow knowledge from building a consumer finance app: merchant of record, card settlement timing, store payouts (narrated without credential claims)
Callback to the channel's own explainer (approved ≠ paid, cycle 001)
OPTIONAL: creator hand clip pressing a generic controller button (no console logos)

anchor.desc: round heist table under a hanging lamp with an 80-coin bag and four seats; corner tracker shows hand 1-4; a coin-made wall clock above the table for timing

ip_rules: No GTA/Rockstar footage, trailer, logo, cover art, characters, map or font; no console brand logos. Generic controller, generic kiosks. 'GTA 6' only in title and narration.

narration.en: Midnight, November nineteenth, and you press Buy on GTA 6 for seventy-nine ninety-nine. The game starts downloading. The money doesn't.
narration.id: Tengah malam, sembilan belas November, kamu menekan Buy untuk GTA 6, tujuh puluh sembilan dolar sembilan puluh sembilan. Gamenya mulai terunduh. Uangnya belum.

narration.en: By the end of that day, fans had spent three point seven nine billion dollars on this one game. Take-Two, the company that owns Rockstar, calls it the biggest launch in entertainment history.
narration.id: Sampai hari itu berakhir, penggemar sudah menghabiskan tiga koma tujuh sembilan miliar dolar untuk satu game ini. Take-Two, perusahaan pemilik Rockstar, menyebutnya peluncuran terbesar dalam sejarah hiburan.

Take-Two calls it the biggest entertainment launch in history

narration.en: Here's the part most headlines skip. Out of your eighty dollars, the publisher gets about fifty-six. And it doesn't get it that night.
narration.id: Ini bagian yang dilewatkan kebanyakan berita. Dari delapan puluh dolarmu, publisher dapat sekitar lima puluh enam. Dan uang itu tidak datang malam itu juga.

narration.en: Four hands touch your money before then. This video follows each one, and the clock that decides when the money actually lands.
narration.id: Ada empat tangan yang menyentuh uangmu sebelum itu. Video ini mengikuti satu per satu, dan jam yang menentukan kapan uang itu benar-benar sampai.

shots.motion: clock hand ticks; camera tilts up to it

narration.en: Picture your payment as a bag of eighty coins: the take from a job. In GTA, a crew splits the take at a table after a heist. Your eighty dollars gets split the same way, just with more paperwork.
narration.id: Bayangkan pembayaranmu sebagai kantong berisi delapan puluh koin: hasil dari sebuah pekerjaan. Di GTA, sebuah kru membagi hasil di meja setelah perampokan. Delapan puluh dolarmu dibagi dengan cara yang sama, hanya dengan lebih banyak kertas.

shots.motion: morph from silhouettes to buildings, paper stacks pop up

narration.en: Four players sit at this table. The state, which adds tax on top. The console store that sold you the download. The card system that moves the money. And the publisher, Take-Two, sitting last.
narration.id: Empat pemain duduk di meja ini. Negara, yang menambahkan pajak di atas harga. Toko console yang menjual unduhan itu. Sistem kartu yang memindahkan uangnya. Dan publisher, Take-Two, duduk paling akhir.

narration.en: Most people guess the publisher takes nearly all of it, because the publisher made the game. It feels right, since the publisher paid for years of work. At this table, the publisher is served last, and gets what's left.
narration.id: Kebanyakan orang menebak publisher mengambil hampir semuanya, karena merekalah yang membuat gamenya. Rasanya wajar, karena publisher yang membiayai kerja bertahun-tahun. Di meja ini, publisher dilayani paling akhir, dan mendapat sisanya.

narration.en: One word to watch first. Three point seven nine billion is retail sales: what buyers paid, counted at the till. Revenue is what a company keeps after everyone else takes a cut. Headlines print the first number.
narration.id: Satu istilah yang perlu diperhatikan dulu. Tiga koma tujuh sembilan miliar itu retail sales: yang dibayar pembeli, dihitung di kasir. Revenue adalah yang disimpan perusahaan setelah semua pihak lain mengambil bagiannya. Berita memuat angka yang pertama.

sources.claim: Take-Two: $3.79B day-one retail sales, company estimate through end of Nov 19; 32.5M copies sold before launch

narration.en: First hand: the state. In most US states, sales tax rides on top of the price, so the bag is heavier than eighty coins before anyone sits down.
narration.id: Tangan pertama: negara. Di sebagian besar negara bagian Amerika, pajak penjualan ditambahkan di atas harga, jadi kantongnya sudah lebih berat dari delapan puluh koin sebelum ada yang duduk.

shots.show: the capitol building stands, its hand hovering over the bag; the clock-anchor in the corner shows hand 1 of 4 lit
shots.motion: hand lowers, corner tracker lights segment 1

shots.show: extra coins stack on top of the 80, the bag stretches and sags
shots.motion: coins drop one by one on top; bag bulges

narration.en: In a state with seven percent tax, that's about five dollars sixty. The store collects it, and passes it to the government. It never belonged to anyone at the table. In a state with no sales tax, like Oregon, the bag stays at exactly eighty.
narration.id: Di negara bagian dengan pajak tujuh persen, itu sekitar lima dolar enam puluh. Toko yang memungutnya, lalu menyetorkannya ke pemerintah. Uang itu sejak awal bukan milik siapa pun di meja. Di negara bagian tanpa pajak penjualan, seperti Oregon, kantongnya tetap delapan puluh.

narration.en: Second hand, and the big one: the console store. It takes thirty percent of the price. On seventy-nine ninety-nine, that's twenty-four dollars.
narration.id: Tangan kedua, dan yang terbesar: toko console. Toko ini mengambil tiga puluh persen dari harga. Dari tujuh puluh sembilan sembilan puluh sembilan, itu dua puluh empat dolar.

shots.show: tracker segment 2 lights; the store kiosk leans across the table
shots.motion: kiosk stretches over the pile

shots.motion: stack slides, counter ticks to 24

sources.claim: Sweeney (Epic v Google): Nintendo, PlayStation, Xbox all charge 30% for games

narration.en: That number isn't a secret. In the Epic versus Google trial, Epic's chief executive confirmed that Nintendo, PlayStation and Xbox all charge thirty percent on games.
narration.id: Angka itu bukan rahasia. Dalam sidang Epic melawan Google, chief executive Epic mengonfirmasi bahwa Nintendo, PlayStation, dan Xbox semuanya memungut tiga puluh persen untuk game.

shots.motion: drawer opens, sheet rises and turns

shots.motion: courtroom fades in; the three cards flip up together

sources.claim: Sweeney (Epic v Google): Nintendo, PlayStation, Xbox all charge 30% for games

narration.en: There's something you need to know about console makers. They sell the console itself cheaply, often at a loss, and earn it back later, from every game sold in their store. The console gets you through the door. The store is where the house makes its money.
narration.id: Ada satu hal yang perlu kamu tahu soal pembuat console. Mereka menjual console-nya murah, sering kali rugi, lalu mengembalikannya nanti dari setiap game yang terjual di toko mereka. Console membuatmu masuk ke dalam. Toko adalah tempat bandar mendapat uangnya.

sources.claim: Epic CFO Gelber: consoles subsidize hardware, sold at a loss per published reports, fee needs to cover that; considers console markets competitive

narration.en: Scale it up. If ten million copies sold through one store at full price, that store's cut would be two hundred and forty million dollars, from a game it didn't make.
narration.id: Perbesar skalanya. Kalau sepuluh juta kopi terjual lewat satu toko dengan harga penuh, bagian toko itu dua ratus empat puluh juta dolar, dari game yang tidak mereka buat.

narration.en: Which store matters too. Analysts at Alinea estimate PlayStation took about three of every four copies sold on launch weekend. A boxed copy from a shop takes a different road, where the shop keeps its own margin. To keep the bag simple, this video follows the download.
narration.id: Toko mana yang dipakai juga penting. Analis di Alinea memperkirakan PlayStation mengambil sekitar tiga dari setiap empat kopi yang terjual di akhir pekan peluncuran. Kopi dalam kotak dari toko fisik menempuh jalan lain, dan tokonya menyimpan marginnya sendiri. Supaya kantongnya tetap sederhana, video ini mengikuti versi unduhan.

narration.en: Third hand: the card, and a twist. Who pays the card fee on your eighty dollars? Not Rockstar.
narration.id: Tangan ketiga: kartu, dan ada twist-nya. Siapa yang membayar biaya kartu dari delapan puluh dolarmu? Bukan Rockstar.

shots.show: tracker segment 3 lights; the card gate rolls up to the table
shots.motion: gate rolls in, conveyor whirs

shots.show: a small question-mark coin spins above the table
shots.motion: coin spins and hovers

shots.show: the office tower shakes its head; the question coin floats away from it
shots.motion: tower shakes, coin drifts toward the store

narration.en: When you buy from a console store, the store is the seller. Its name is on your receipt, and it's the one the card system charges. That role has a name: the merchant of record.
narration.id: Saat kamu membeli dari toko console, tokonya yang menjadi penjual. Namanya tertulis di struk, dan dialah yang ditagih sistem kartu. Peran itu punya nama: merchant of record.

shots.show: a receipt prints out of the kiosk with the store's name at the top
shots.motion: receipt unrolls

shots.motion: stamp swings onto the kiosk

shots.show: the store kiosk gets a little badge pinned on it
shots.motion: badge pins on with a pop

narration.en: So the card fee comes out of the store's twenty-four dollars. On a typical US card, that fee is a couple of percent, roughly two dollars here. A company Sony's size likely pays less, but its rate isn't public.
narration.id: Jadi biaya kartu diambil dari dua puluh empat dolar milik toko. Untuk kartu biasa di Amerika, biayanya sekitar dua persen, kira-kira dua dolar di sini. Perusahaan sebesar Sony kemungkinan membayar lebih kecil, tapi tarifnya tidak dipublikasikan.

shots.motion: gate's arm dips into the store's stack

shots.show: two coins lift out and ride the conveyor
shots.motion: two coins pop onto the conveyor

shots.show: a frosted-glass rate card with blurred numbers
shots.motion: glass fogs over the numbers

narration.en: Those two dollars have their own split, between your bank, the card network and the store's payment company. That one gets its own video on this channel.
narration.id: Dua dolar itu punya pembagiannya sendiri, antara bankmu, jaringan kartu, dan perusahaan pembayaran milik toko. Itu akan dibahas di video tersendiri di channel ini.

narration.en: Fourth hand: the publisher, which gets what's left after the store's cut, fifty-five dollars and ninety-nine cents. That's seventy percent.
narration.id: Tangan keempat: publisher, yang mendapat sisa setelah bagian toko, lima puluh lima dolar sembilan puluh sembilan sen. Itu tujuh puluh persen.

narration.en: It sounds like plenty, until you put it next to what the game cost. Reports put GTA 6's budget at more than a billion dollars, built over more than a decade. Rockstar has never confirmed a number.
narration.id: Kedengarannya banyak, sampai kamu menaruhnya di samping biaya pembuatannya. Laporan menyebut anggaran GTA 6 lebih dari satu miliar dolar, dikerjakan lebih dari satu dekade. Rockstar tidak pernah mengonfirmasi angkanya.

narration.en: At fifty-six dollars a copy, a billion dollars takes about eighteen million downloads just to pay back. That's before marketing. Eighteen million is roughly everyone in the Netherlands buying one copy each.
narration.id: Dengan lima puluh enam dolar per kopi, satu miliar dolar butuh sekitar delapan belas juta unduhan hanya untuk balik modal. Itu belum termasuk biaya pemasaran. Delapan belas juta itu kira-kira seluruh penduduk Belanda masing-masing membeli satu kopi.

narration.en: Take-Two says thirty-two and a half million copies were sold before the game even launched. Even with boxed copies and lower margins mixed in, that's far past eighteen million.
narration.id: Take-Two menyebut tiga puluh dua setengah juta kopi sudah terjual sebelum gamenya rilis. Meskipun bercampur dengan kopi kotak dan margin yang lebih kecil, angka itu jauh melewati delapan belas juta.

narration.en: So everyone at the table gets paid. Just not on launch night.
narration.id: Jadi semua orang di meja dibayar. Hanya saja, tidak di malam peluncuran.

narration.en: Three point seven nine billion in a single day works out to about forty-four thousand dollars every second. Five times what GTA 5 made on its first day in 2013. Take that single day, and it roughly matches what the last two Avatar films grossed combined.
narration.id: Tiga koma tujuh sembilan miliar dalam satu hari berarti sekitar empat puluh empat ribu dolar setiap detik. Lima kali lipat dari yang didapat GTA 5 di hari pertamanya pada 2013. Satu hari itu kira-kira setara dengan pendapatan dua film Avatar terakhir digabung.

GTA V 2013 previous record ~$800M; GTA VI dev cost estimated ~$1B
Take-Two calls it the biggest entertainment launch in history

narration.en: But as the last video on this channel showed, approved is not paid. When your card says approved, your bank has made a promise. The money itself moves later, in batches, usually in one to three days.
narration.id: Tapi seperti di video sebelumnya di channel ini, approved belum berarti dibayar. Saat kartumu bilang approved, bankmu baru membuat janji. Uangnya sendiri berpindah belakangan, dalam satu kumpulan, biasanya dalam satu sampai tiga hari.

narration.en: So for a purchase made at midnight, your coins were still sitting at your bank. The store had a promise. Take-Two had a number on a sales counter.
narration.id: Jadi untuk pembelian tengah malam, koin-koinmu masih ada di bankmu. Toko memegang janji. Take-Two memegang angka di penghitung penjualan.

shots.show: inside your bank's vault, your 80-coin bag with a midnight clock on the wall

shots.motion: card glows and flickers

narration.en: Days later, the card money settles with the store. Then the store pays the publisher, on a payout schedule written into a contract the public never gets to read. If that schedule pays once a month, a sale on November nineteenth might not reach the publisher until December.
narration.id: Beberapa hari kemudian, uang kartu sampai ke toko. Lalu toko membayar publisher, sesuai jadwal pembayaran yang tertulis di kontrak yang tidak pernah bisa dibaca publik. Kalau jadwal itu membayar sebulan sekali, penjualan tanggal sembilan belas November mungkin baru sampai ke publisher di bulan Desember.

narration.en: That's how a company can announce a record day, while its money is still travelling. The trophy is real. The coins are still on a truck.
narration.id: Begitulah sebuah perusahaan bisa mengumumkan hari rekor, sementara uangnya masih dalam perjalanan. Pialanya nyata. Koinnya masih di atas truk.

narration.en: Is thirty percent a rip-off? Someone took that question to court.
narration.id: Apakah tiga puluh persen itu kemahalan? Ada yang membawa pertanyaan itu ke pengadilan.

shots.show: the 24-coin stack on a courtroom scale, light cold blue
shots.motion: scale tips back and forth

shots.show: a courthouse exterior, the store kiosk walking up the steps with a briefcase
shots.motion: kiosk climbs the steps, doors swing open

narration.en: In London, a class action on behalf of about twelve million PlayStation users argued that the store's cut made prices unfair. On November seventeenth, two days before GTA 6 launched, the tribunal threw the claim out.
narration.id: Di London, sebuah gugatan kelompok atas nama sekitar dua belas juta pengguna PlayStation berargumen bahwa potongan toko membuat harga tidak adil. Pada tujuh belas November, dua hari sebelum GTA 6 rilis, tribunal menolak gugatan itu.

shots.show: a crowd of 12 million dots forms the shape of a courtroom gallery
shots.motion: dots stream in and settle

shots.show: a calendar flips to Nov 17, gavel bangs, the claim paper flies out of the courtroom window; a second calendar page shows Nov 19 two days later
shots.motion: gavel bangs, paper flies, calendar flips forward two days

sources.claim: CAT London dismissed the $2.6B claim over the 30% cut on Nov 17, 2026
Panel: class rep failed to establish Sony infringed competition law; ~12.2M UK users

narration.en: And here's the store's side, told fairly. It built the console, it runs the servers that deliver a game this size overnight, and it handles refunds and fraud. Epic's finance chief said in court that the cut is needed because consoles are sold at a loss.
narration.id: Dan ini sisi toko, diceritakan dengan adil. Toko membuat console-nya, menjalankan server yang mengirim game sebesar ini dalam semalam, dan mengurus refund serta penipuan. Kepala keuangan Epic mengatakan di pengadilan bahwa potongan itu diperlukan karena console dijual rugi.

narration.en: That's the same Epic that sued Apple and Google over their thirty percent. On consoles, it called the market competitive and paid the cut.
narration.id: Ini Epic yang sama yang menggugat Apple dan Google karena tiga puluh persen mereka. Untuk console, Epic menyebut pasarnya kompetitif dan membayar potongannya.

narration.en: Back to the table. From your seventy-nine ninety-nine, twenty-four went to the store, and about two of that went to the card system. Fifty-six went to the publisher. The tax on top went to the state.
narration.id: Kembali ke meja. Dari tujuh puluh sembilan sembilan puluh sembilan, dua puluh empat ke toko, dan sekitar dua dari situ ke sistem kartu. Lima puluh enam ke publisher. Pajak di atasnya ke negara.

narration.en: And none of it landed the night you pressed Buy. The split happens at the table. The payment happens on the clock.
narration.id: Dan tidak ada yang sampai di malam kamu menekan Buy. Pembagiannya terjadi di meja. Pembayarannya mengikuti jam.

narration.en: So the next time a game makes billions in a day, ask two things. Who keeps it? And when does it land?
narration.id: Jadi lain kali ada game yang menghasilkan miliaran dalam sehari, tanyakan dua hal. Siapa yang menyimpannya? Dan kapan uangnya sampai?
